simple.meaning: מִבְטָא (mibṭâʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “a rash utterance (hasty vow).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מִבְטָא (H4008) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 30:7, with occurrences in Numbers.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מִבְטָא (H4008) before moving outward to related references.
